fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header, or with Accept-Encoding: identity, and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that accepts gzip can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: First downloaded on 2026-09-25 at 12:45Z by the researcher and downloaded again at 12:58 and 13:29Z; the independent check downloaded it again at 13:42 and 14:13Z. Every download had the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded again for this packet at 2026-09-25T15:28Z (integration pass) with the same byte count and SHA-256.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the original page, captured at 2025-11-14T03:16:52Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of the live page. Fetched without Accept-Encoding (curl without --compressed), the archive serves it uncompressed: the recorded byte count and SHA-256 are those of the uncompressed body. The response identity was confirmed by downloads at least 30 minutes apart (see stability_check). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

scope_note: Raw capture (14 November 2025) of the Presidency's retrospective, undated profile, a live Drupal page with rotating side blocks (the capture fixes the bytes). The capture records that the crawler received gzip; the archive replays the body uncompressed.
